_comment: Descriptions for the boolean harness-level flags mas_workflow.py's run_task() returns (crashed/budget_exhausted/scout_any_crashed/optimizer_no_plan/executor_failed_final), tallied generically by scorer_impl.py::aggregate()'s harness_checks (any True-valued flag in agent_metadata, same convention travel_mas_refactored's own harness_checks uses -- deliberately not hardcoded beyond 'tally whatever's True', so this file stays correct if mas_workflow.py gains more flags later without a scorer change). These describe genuine HARNESS/pipeline failures (the run never produced a meaningful attempt), distinct from error_semantics.json's failure_cause:*/budget:*/coupon:* entries, which describe TASK-level imperfections in an otherwise-completed cart.
crashed: The case's run_task() raised an uncaught exception somewhere in the pipeline (requirement_parser/product_scout/cart_optimizer/cart_executor orchestration itself, not a normal agent-produced-a-bad-answer case) -- caught by run_task()'s own outer try/except so it doesn't take down the whole batch, recorded with the exception type/message/traceback.
budget_exhausted: The case hit its per-case LLM-call budget (cfg.max_llm_calls, shared across all 4 pipeline stages and all concurrent product_scout instances via CallCounter) before finishing -- LLMBudgetExceeded was raised and the case was abandoned rather than completed.
scout_any_crashed: At least one line item's product_scout invocation hit its own except Exception branch (scout.run() itself raised, not just returned a poor result) -- that item fell back to an empty candidate list with a 'scout crashed: ...' note rather than a real search result.
optimizer_no_plan: cart_optimizer.run() returned None on every attempt (its own optimize+audit+minimal-schema-retry escalation all failed to produce a parseable plan) -- the case never reached cart_executor at all, there was no cart to even try to build.
executor_failed_final: After the full optimize<->execute repair loop ended (success, or exhausting cfg.max_repair_iterations, or running out of distinct failed-product exclusions to retry with), the LAST cart_executor attempt's own status was still not 'ok' -- the agent never got a cart it believed was successfully built, as opposed to a cart that built fine but scores imperfectly against ground truth.
